# Textarea

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use a textarea when users need to enter more than one line of free text.

## When to use

- Use when the expected answer may contain sentences or several lines.
- Set rows to suggest a useful starting height without restricting how much users can enter.

## When not to use

- Use a Text input for a short single-line answer.
- Use Character count when a genuine, user-understood maximum length must be enforced.
- Do not ask for large free-text answers when structured questions would be easier to answer and process.

## Anatomy

- **Form group (required):** Groups the visible label, optional hint, optional error and textarea.
- **Label (required):** A visible label is associated using for and id.
- **Native textarea (required):** The govuk-textarea supports multi-line input and browser resizing.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `textarea` | `govuk-textarea` | A multi-line answer without a strict character limit. |
| Error | `textarea` | `govuk-textarea`, `govuk-textarea--error` | Redisplay an invalid answer with a linked error message. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- The base textarea requires no GOV.UK JavaScript.
- Allow native resizing and retain the submitted answer after recoverable validation errors.
- Validate on the server and store line breaks safely.

## Accessibility contract

- Associate a visible label and reference hint and error IDs in aria-describedby.
- Do not use placeholder text instead of a label or hint.
- Do not disable browser resizing or clip enlarged text.

## Content rules

- Ask a focused question and explain what information to include.
- Say how the answer will be used when users may disclose sensitive information.
- Avoid unnecessary maximum lengths; when one is necessary explain it before input.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.input-border`
- `govuk.color.error`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.color.focus-text`

## HTML examples

### More detail

```html
<div class="govuk-form-group">
  <label class="govuk-label" for="more-detail">Can you provide more detail?</label>
  <textarea class="govuk-textarea" id="more-detail" name="moreDetail" rows="5"></textarea>
</div>
```
